name: @taste-and-see/service-analytics
description: Analytics & reporting bounded context (PDD §7.2 service inventory entry #17, §23). Owns the read-side aggregations, dashboard marts, and scheduled reports computed from platform domain events (PDD §23.1 — raw events to Cassandra, nightly aggregation to PostgreSQL marts). TS-217-prep-2 shipped the NestJS 11 + Prisma + Postgres skeleton (`analytics` schema, `analytics_aggregation_runs` placeholder, `/healthz` + `/readyz`, tenant-scoped per TS-141 `enforce` mode). TS-217-prep-3a wires the `@taste-and-see/nest-outbox-consumer` SDK so service-analytics drains `search.performed` (TS-217-prep-1) + `booking.created` into idempotent Postgres landing tables (`analytics.search_events` + `analytics.booking_created_events`). TS-217-prep-3b adds the nightly search-relevance aggregation: an internal shared-secret (+ admin) compute endpoint reads the raw landing tables for a UTC-day window and writes the `analytics.search_relevance_daily` / `search_query_daily` / `search_sort_daily` marts (top queries, zero-result rate, searches-per-sort, approximate query→booking conversion), stamping one `analytics_aggregation_runs` row per run; driven nightly by the `analytics-aggregator` worker.
